# 2 Chronicles Chapter 4 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-he-made an-altar-of bronze twenty cubits its-length and-twenty cubits its-width and-ten cubits its-height.

**2** And-he-made the-sea cast ten in-the-cubit from-its-rim to its-rim round all-around and-five in-the-cubit its-height and-a-line-of thirty in-the-cubit surrounding it all-around.

**3** And-likeness-of oxen under-it all-around surrounding it ten in-the-cubit surrounding the-sea all-around two rows-of the-oxen cast in-its-casting.

**4** Standing on twelve oxen three facing north and-three facing west and-three facing south and-three facing east and-the-sea upon-them from-above and-all their-hindquarters inward.

**5** And-its-thickness a-handbreadth and-its-rim like-work-of rim-of a-cup flower-of a-lily holding baths three-thousand it-contained.

**6** And-he-made basins ten and-he-put five from-the-right and-five from-the-left to-wash in-them the-work-of the-burnt-offering they-rinsed in-them and-the-sea was-for the-priests to-wash in-it.

**7** And-he-made the-lampstands-of gold ten according-to-their-specification and-he-set in-the-temple five from-the-right and-five from-the-left.

**8** And-he-made tables ten and-he-placed in-the-temple five from-the-right and-five from-the-left and-he-made bowls-of gold a-hundred.

**9** And-he-made court-of the-priests and-the-great enclosure and-doors for-the-enclosure and-their-doors he-overlaid with-bronze.

**10** And-the-sea he-set from-the-side the-right from-the-front toward-the-south-east.

**11** And-Huram made the-pots and-the-shovels and-the-bowls and-Huram finished to-do the-work that he-did for-the-king Solomon in-house-of God:

**12** pillars two and-the-bowls and-the-capitals on-top-of the-pillars two and-the-networks two to-cover the-bowls two of-the-capitals that were-on top-of the-pillars.

**13** And-the-pomegranates four-hundred for-the-two networks two rows-of pomegranates for-the-one network to-cover the-bowls two of-the-capitals that were-on the-face-of the-pillars.

**14** And-the-stands he-made and-the-basins he-made on the-stands.

**15** The-sea one and-the-oxen twelve under-it.

**16** And-the-pots and-the-shovels and-the-forks and-all their-vessels made Huram-abi for-the-king Solomon for-house-of YHWH of-bronze polished.

**17** In-the-plain-of the-Jordan cast-them the-king in-the-thickness-of the-ground between Succoth and-Zeredah.

**18** And-he-made Solomon all the-vessels these in-great abundance for not was-searched-out weight-of the-bronze.

**19** And-he-made Solomon all the-vessels that were-for house-of God and the-altar-of gold and-the-tables and-upon-them bread-of the-presence.

**20** And-the-lampstands and-their-lamps of-gold pure to-burn according-to-the-rule before the-inner-sanctuary.

**21** And-the-flowers and-the-lamps and-the-tongs gold it was-gold perfect.

**22** And-the-snuffers and-the-bowls and-the-spoons and-the-firepans gold pure and-the-entrance-of the-house its-inner doors to-the-holy-of-holies and-doors-of the-house to-the-temple of-gold.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **4:2**: the-sea cast — The molten sea was a massive bronze basin for priestly ablution. Its dimensions and oxen-base echo cosmic symbolism — the primordial waters tamed by divine order.

- **4:5**: baths three-thousand — Chronicles gives 3,000 baths; Kings gives 2,000. The Chronicler may use a different measurement standard or deliberately magnify the temple's capacity.

- **4:17**: between Succoth and-Zeredah — The Jordan plain foundries indicate massive industrial-scale metalworking, far from the temple site itself.


— EMET
